research.locationNote: Business Bay, close to Sheikh Zayed Road and Downtown Dubai.
overview: Planned mix: 432 apartments, 76 duplexes, 13 penthouses and one Royal Palace; these are design counts, not available stock.
The developer targets Q4 2029; shoring preparation and design coordination are underway.
research.priceNote: Property Finder displays a rounded AED 2.1m starting reference. No current official unit quotation was retrieved.
research.paymentNote: Original 50/50 calendar below. A later broker advertises 30% post-handover for duplexes and penthouses; no developer amendment was retrieved.
research.handoverNote: Developer Q4 2029 differs from Property Finder December 2030. Obtain the selected home’s contractual date.

Printed component sums vary by 1 ft². Whole-home duplex and Palace areas must not be multiplied by floor count.
